facets.description: The _ids branch always deletes the raw id array, even when _lookupSubType resolves nothing. The ids are lost and replaced with an array of undefined.
Writing to obj[pluralize(subType)] can overwrite a real field that already has that name.
obj[k].map is called without a null or array check, so a null *_ids value throws a TypeError.
The `hydrated || []` guard is dead code because map always returns an array.
